messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty: Alert INC-8472 fired for hosted-inference-prod — monitor=error-rate-high, threshold=5% over 2m. Policy=infra-critical. Paging primary: @devon. Auto-escalation=5m. Duplicate suppression active (burst-suppress v2).

devon: acked. I'm on it, jumping to logs.

devon: I only see the primary page — did the secondary get paged? I don't see any manager page.

incidentbot: PagerDuty: Auto-escalation started — paging secondary oncall: @margo (policy window exceeded 5m). Note: suppression rule suppressed repeated pages from monitor-hosted-inference-prod. Manager escalation queued.

margo: I did not get the first set of suppression-lifted pages until now. Joining bridge: https://meet.redwood/incident/8472

alex: On bridge. Quick status: traffic to hosted-inference is failing 502s for embedding endpoints, spike in token latency. Rolling a temporary route to dedicated-pool-3 now.

jordan: Customer impact? Any active SLAs breaking?

devon: ~20% of requests getting 502 across EU region, some customers reporting timeouts. Not full outage but degraded (affects inference-heavy features).

devon: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T12:34:56Z] inference: request failed status=502 model=base-2.7 batch=1 err="KV cache miss + OOM retry"
[2026-03-17T12:34:58Z] runtime: queue-depth=180 latency_p50=120ms p95=1.2s
```

margo: Looks like runtime kernel evictions hitting newly deployed quantized build. Reverting to last-known-good build and restarting 2 pods.

alex: reroute done: traffic routed to dedicated-pool-3 for EU. Telemetry shows success — error-rate down to ~6%.

incidentbot: PagerDuty: Manager escalation fired — paging manager: @jordan after chain escalation (primary ack delayed, suppression prevented secondary earlier). Manager page includes incident link.

jordan: I saw the manager page and am here. Good call on reroute — can we keep traffic on dedicated for now while we validate rollback?

devon: Revert complete; pod restarts healthy. Error-rate down to 1.2% after 90s post-rollback and routing.

margo: Confirmed — rolling verification: no new 502s in the last 2 minutes.

alex: Manual override note: suppression rule blocked a batch of pages during the initial spike, which slowed secondary awareness. We'll open a ticket to adjust suppression thresholds for hosts with fast-fail behavior.

jordan: Agreed. Action items: 1) postmortem + timeline, 2) adjust burst-suppress thresholds, 3) test auto-escalation chain, 4) followup with customers who reported errors. I'll file PM ticket.

devon: tagging as mitigated. I'll hand the incident to margo for post-incident cleanup and the postmortem.

margo: Picking this up for postmortem. Please add any notes here. I'll attach runbook steps and timeline.

incidentbot: Incident INC-8472 status: mitigated. Duration: ~18m. PagerDuty notes: suppression caused delayed secondary paging; manager escalation occurred. Postmortem required.

jordan: Thanks team. :heart: Closing here — move to #postmortems/8472 when ready.
